entities.summary: Kyambogo University (KYU) is a public university in Uganda. It is one of the largest and most prestigious universities in Uganda, and is among the eight public universities and degree-awarding institutions in the country. Its motto is "Knowledge and Skills for Service.". Kyambogo University is a university in Africa, established in 2003. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
